children: Tonix Pharmaceuticals announced a new managed Medicare agreement adding ~21 million Medicare Part D beneficiaries for TONMYA, bringing total commercial and government coverage to ~166 million U.S. lives.
New agreement effective immediately provides TONMYA coverage for ~21 million Medicare Part D beneficiaries.
Medicare coverage for TONMYA now totals 32 million lives (≈58% of ~55 million Medicare lives in U.S.).
Total commercial and government payer coverage reaches ~166 million covered lives (≈53% of ~314 million U.S. lives).
Company says the agreement should increase patient access as TONMYA is the first fibromyalgia treatment approved in >15 years.
Tonix notes expanded sales force (150 reps, ~50 newly activated) to support launch and translate coverage into patient access.
